title: VESPER AutonomyEnableToken
description: REM-005 / FV-01. The system is not STOPPED by an act; it is PERMITTED TO RUN by a continuously renewed act. Absence of permission is the safe state, so every failure of the control path -- severed, wedged, compromised, powered off -- halts autonomy rather than releasing it. A kill signal fails that requirement by construction, because it must be DELIVERED by a healthy path. Authority: RB-030, RB-031, RB-035, P-010, DR-023, DR-027, T-007.

token_id.description: Single-use per actuation-gate epoch. Replay is rejected (INV-STOP-4).

scope.description: Independently revocable. STOP_AUTONOMY (single press) halts autonomous actuation while alarms continue -- an emergency stop must not silently defeat SR-043, whose source states the user is a heavy sleeper and the system 'must not stop'. STOP_ALL (press-and-hold >= 5 s) halts both.

valid_until.description: issued_at + TOKEN_TTL (default 30 s), renewed every 10 s so two consecutive renewal failures still leave margin. Verified per ACTION, not per session or per task.

signature.description: Signed with the interlock's key, which is NOT in the runtime secret store and is not reachable by any runtime capability. The runtime therefore cannot mint, extend, replay or forge a token (INV-STOP-4).
